book_meta.work: Le Tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours
book_meta.author: Jules Verne

sentences.en: And after Singapore, the weather changed.
Strong wind, waves, the steamer rolling.
And the captain said: we will be late.
And Fogg said: how much?
The captain said: a day.
Maybe two.
And Fogg calculated.

sentences.ar: الباخرة من هونغ كونغ ليوكوهاما بتطلع يوم 5 نوفمبر.
sentences.en: The steamer from Hong Kong to Yokohama leaves 5 November.
And if we are two days late, we arrive on the 6th.
And lose a week.
And Fix was pleased by the storm.
Every hour of delay, a chance.
And Passepartout was furious at the storm.

sentences.ar: وقف عالسطح، ويصرخ عالريح، ويتخانق مع البحر.
sentences.en: He stood on deck, shouting at the wind, quarrelling with the sea.

sentences.ar: وفيكس بيتفرج، ويقول: هالخادم مجنون على سيده.
sentences.en: And Fix watched, and said: this servant is mad about his master.
He does not know he is a thief.

sentences.ar: وعودا سألت فوغ: وإذا فاتتنا الباخرة؟
sentences.en: And Aouda asked Fogg: and if we miss the steamer?
Fogg said: we take the next.
She said: and you come back after the eighty days?
Fogg said: perhaps.
She said: and lose twenty thousand?
Fogg said: perhaps.
Aouda said: and it does not matter to you?

sentences.ar: قال فوغ: بيهمني إني أعمل اللي قلت إني بعمله.
sentences.en: Fogg said: it matters to me to do what I said I would do.
The rest is arithmetic.

sentences.ar: وهدأت الريح، ووصلوا هونغ كونغ يوم 6 نوفمبر، الصبح.
sentences.en: And the wind dropped, and they reached Hong Kong on 6 November, in the morning.
A day late.
And Passepartout ran down to the harbour.
And asked: the Yokohama steamer, the Carnatic, has it left?
The man said: no.
They are repairing the engine.
It leaves tomorrow morning.
And Passepartout danced on the quay.
And ran to tell Fogg.
And Fogg said: good.
So, on time.
